componentModels.responsibility: The component defines interfaces and a function related to handling binding of HTTP request data such as JSON, query parameters, and form data.

publicSymbols.name: Binding
publicSymbols.docComment:
Binding describes the interface which needs to be implemented for binding the
data present in the request such as JSON request body, query parameters or
the form POST.

publicSymbols.name: BindingBody
publicSymbols.docComment:
BindingBody adds BindBody method to Binding. BindBody is similar with Bind,
but it reads the body from supplied bytes instead of req.Body.

publicSymbols.name: BindingUri
publicSymbols.docComment:
BindingUri adds BindUri method to Binding. BindUri is similar with Bind,
but it reads the Params.

publicSymbols.name: StructValidator
publicSymbols.docComment:
StructValidator is the minimal interface which needs to be implemented in
order for it to be used as the validator engine for ensuring the correctness
of the request. Gin provides a default implementation for this using
https://github.com/go-playground/validator/tree/v10.6.1.

publicSymbols.name: Default
publicSymbols.docComment:
Default returns the appropriate Binding instance based on the HTTP method
and the content type.

externalCalls.name: http
externalCalls.reason: The component interacts with HTTP methods and types.

errorPaths: Invalid HTTP method or content type in Default function

componentModels.responsibility: The component is responsible for validating structs and providing error handling for validation failures in Go, using the validator library.

publicSymbols.name: Error
publicSymbols.docComment: Error concatenates all error elements in SliceValidationError into a single string separated by \n.

publicSymbols.name: ValidateStruct
publicSymbols.docComment: ValidateStruct receives any kind of type, but only performed struct or pointer to struct type.

publicSymbols.name: Engine
publicSymbols.docComment:
Engine returns the underlying validator engine which powers the default
Validator instance. This is useful if you want to register custom validations
or struct level validations. See validator GoDoc for more info -
https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-playground/validator/v10

errorPaths: Validation failure due to invalid struct fields
Nil pointer dereference when the input is nil
Reflection error when inspecting the struct
Error during initialization of validator engine
sideEffects: Mutation of validation errors into SliceValidationError
